title: Preregistered pipeline recovers governing equations exactly and generalizes them beyond the discovery regime
problem: Can autonomous sparse-regression discovery recover known governing equations from simulation data exactly, under held-out ICs, unseen parameter regimes, and noise, without confusing curve fitting with discovery?
hypothesis: STLSQ with chronological-validation threshold selection and 6th-order derivative stencils recovers exact equation sets (coefficient error <1e-6 clean, correct support, rollout <5%) for polynomial-library systems, and discovered closed-form laws extrapolate beyond their training regime.
baseline: SINDy (Brunton et al., PNAS 2016, arXiv:1509.03580); STLSQ analysis (Zhang & Schaeffer 2019, arXiv:1805.06445); baselines OLS-full/Ridge/Lasso per PREREGISTERED.md
proposed_improvement: No method novelty claimed (replication study). Contributions: validation-split threshold selection robust to correlated FD error; significance-test support criterion; demonstration that recovered laws generalize out-of-regime (pendulum period to 120 deg, Kepler across unseen mu/e, RLC to unseen circuits).

experimental_evidence.what: exact recovery of 3/3 systems incl. Lorenz

experimental_evidence.result: LV recovery to sigma=0.005; honest degradation documented; results/exp02_noise.json

experimental_evidence.what: Kepler III + eccentricity invariance + drag falsification
experimental_evidence.result: exponents exact to 8 digits, held-out RMS 9.2e-11 over all unseen cells, e-coefs |c|<1e-6, drag drift -47%/orbit flagged
coefficients match P6 theory; extrapolation err 8.4e-6@45deg..1.9e-2@120deg vs small-angle law 3.8e-2..2.7e-1; unseen g/L=1.25 rel err 4.4e-7
alpha coef 0.50031, omega_d^2 coefs 1.00008/-0.24988; held-out prediction 5.2e-3/6.1e-4
rollouts: ours 1.1e-2/4.3e-2 vs OLS-full 1.0e-1/2.3e-1, Ridge 5.4e-1/2.7e+8, Lasso 5.8e+1/2.7e+0

novelty_notes: Method = SINDy (known). Value is rigorous replication + generalization demonstrations + disclosed engineering fixes; see literature/S6-novelty.md (audit date 2026-08-26).
